work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act names Cardinal Weld protector and apostolic visitor of the Salviati college, the Aquiro orphanage and the Santi Quattro nuns. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF11753; own dating clause LF11878–11881 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo » primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF11742 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
